# Daily Report — 2026-07-25

## Task Completed
Add `create_scheduled_job`, `update_scheduled_job`, and `delete_scheduled_job` tools
(POST/PATCH/DELETE sysauto_script) to complete full CRUD for scheduled script execution jobs.

- `create_scheduled_job`: POST sysauto_script; requires `name` + `script`; optional `run_type`
  (daily/weekly/monthly/once/periodically), `run_time`, `run_at`, `run_period`,
  `run_dayofweek`, `run_dayofmonth`, `run_start`, `run_as`, `active`; serialises
  `active` as string; excludes None fields from body; returns `sys_id` and formatted job
- `update_scheduled_job`: PATCH sysauto_script by sys_id or exact name; resolves name via
  `_resolve_scheduled_job_sys_id`; empty-body guard; 404 guard; returns updated job record
- `delete_scheduled_job`: DELETE sysauto_script by sys_id or exact name; 404 guard;
  handles 200/204 success codes; returns confirmation message

All three tools registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
